summary: Standing tower in Chisago County per the Minnesota lookout list; no build date, builder or staffing found in the sources reached.

evidence.supports: tower in Chisago County, listed as standing, with coordinates

notes_for_editor: Only one source reached. Two web searches gave no build date, builder, design, staffing or name origin. The list agrees with the record on county, coordinates and standing status. Search snippets mention a Rushseba Township in Chisago County (Minnesota Board of Appraisers docket pages on mba.state.mn.us); the name resemblance is an unconfirmed lead, not used in the story. Worth checking with the Chisago County Historical Society and the state fire-tower catalog linked from firelookout.org. Access and visit fields remain unknown.
